name: km-electronic-filing-and-tax-procedure
description: Comoros (Union of the Comoros) electronic filing and payment (tele-procedures, LPF L.10 bis to L.10 undecies) and selected enforcement rules for tax year 2026, from Finance Law 2026 (Law 25-020/AU), the Amending Finance Law 2024 and the 2023 General Tax Code. Distinguishes the enacted framework from the Director General's decisions and the ministerial order still needed for rollout; explains when an e-return counts as filed and an e-payment as made, authentication and electronic mandates, outages, the eight-working-day electronic answer to an information request, the KMF 100,000 fine and KMF 50,000 per day penalty for obstructing the right of communication, the fiscal-flagrance report with its fifteen-day challenge period, bank reporting of business accounts, the beneficial-owner register, on-site audit length, late-payment interest (10% a month, capped at 50%) and the other charges enacted for 2026. Use for questions such as: is e-filing mandatory in Comoros, when is an electronic tax
